name: notes
label: Notes
description: Durable notes across Git worktrees and context resets. Forks own private copies of selected-branch notes. Ops: list (newest first, size/date; optional folder), read, search (case-insensitive text), write (replace; empty clears), append (one newline-terminated record). list/search discover project-wide notes with scope selectors; use scope for read-only comparisons or a single-scope view. Omit scope for current notes and live references. list/read/search are paged; continue with the returned offset. list shows the current writable directory; current-file reads show an editable path, foreign reads a read-only reference. Edit the returned current path for small changes. A blocked foreign edit may have created a private copy: read that copy before retrying. Append adopts unowned references without losing their text. Keep one concise current-state note and link fuller evidence.
promptSnippet: save and recall durable state with private notes for forks
